name: 炼金植物 4
prompt:
九种浅亮奇幻炼金植物道具，固定顺序：第1至4种为仍在栽培的不同药材盆栽，叶形、枝态和药用特征明显不同，盆内可见泥土；第5至6种为只有泥土而没有植物的空栽培盆，与前四种盆器属于同一设计家族，但盆口、刻纹、足座和釉面分区有所区别；第7种为已采摘的叶片、根茎和干燥花枝组成的炼金素材束，不带花盆；第8至9种为公司入口尺度的大型观赏盆栽，分别是挺拔宽叶型和舒展树形。普通材质颜色仅可选自：#FFFDF6,#FEF9EA,#FDF2D7,#E9DABD,#CDBA97,#F8E8CF,#F1D7B2,#E7C393,#C9A06E,#9E7A55,#FFF7A8,#FCEF72,#F6E24B,#D1B825,#9C8510,#FFF3B7,#FDE674,#FCD75F,#FECD4D,#D1900B,#FFE2A0,#FFD170,#F8BC44,#E39F1A,#A96F05,#FBE3BD,#FDD8A3,#FDCC8F,#F1AD69,#D99256,#FFD2BA,#FFB08A,#FF8A5B,#F06B3E,#B84A27,#EAF9FF,#DAF2F5,#95E5F9,#76D0F
Coordinate contract: local Y+ is up, local Z+ is the front, entrance, or forward direction, and local X+ is right. Put doors, facades, openings, windshields, noses, seats, and other recognizable front details toward local Z+. For a modular repeated element, explicitly choose the long axis: side-by-side modules span local X with depth/front on local Z; traversal modules span local Z. Keep the model centered at its origin.
Canonical dimensions contract: width=1, height=1.4, depth=1 world units. Keep the generated mesh within this centered bounding size.
Create variation 4 of 8; preserve the same reusable asset family while varying silhouette and details.
